title: Sage prefab parts
description: A prefab's "parts": setups a plugin declared ([PrefabPart]), by id, with their options.

abilities.description: Prefab part 'abilities' (AbilitiesPart). A bare value is its "ids".

anyOf.description: Abilities it can cast. Names a ability record. (List<RecordRef<AbilityRecord>>)

bone_attachment.description: Prefab part 'bone_attachment' (BoneAttachmentPart). A bare value is its "socket".

anyOf.description: A socket of the parent's model (skeleton_sockets); empty = follow `bone`. (string, default "")

dialogue.description: Prefab part 'dialogue' (DialoguePart). A bare value is its "id".

anyOf.description: What it says when used. Names a dialogue record. (RecordRef<DialogueRecord>)

effects.description: Prefab part 'effects' (EffectsPart). A bare value is its "ids".

anyOf.description: Effects it starts with. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

faction.description: Prefab part 'faction' (FactionPart). A bare value is its "id".

anyOf.description: The faction it belongs to. Names a faction record. (RecordRef<FactionRecord>)

hitboxes.description: Prefab part 'hitboxes' (HitboxesPart). A bare value is its "model".

anyOf.description: The model whose hitboxes records to use; left out, the skinned_mesh's or the animator's. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

quest_watch.description: Prefab part 'quest_watch' (QuestWatchPart). A bare value is its "quest".

anyOf.description: The quest it listens to: OnStageChanged when it moves. Names a quest record. (RecordRef<QuestRecord>)

routine.description: Prefab part 'routine' (RoutinePart). A bare value is its "id".

anyOf.description: Its daily routine. Names a routine record. (RecordRef<RoutineRecord>)

ids.description: Abilities it can cast. Names a ability record. (List<RecordRef<AbilityRecord>>)

ids+.description: Adds to "ids": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

ids-.description: Removes these from "ids" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

joints.description: The joints that turn, from the hips up. (List<AimIkJoint>)

joint.description: The joint, by name as the model writes it. (string)

weight.description: Its share of the aim; the chain's shares usually add up to 1. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

pitchLimit.description: How far this joint alone may pitch, up or down. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

yawLimit.description: How far this joint alone may yaw, left or right. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

joints+.description: Adds to "joints": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

joint.description: The joint, by name as the model writes it. (string)

weight.description: Its share of the aim; the chain's shares usually add up to 1. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

pitchLimit.description: How far this joint alone may pitch, up or down. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

yawLimit.description: How far this joint alone may yaw, left or right. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

joints-.description: Removes these from "joints" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

joint.description: The joint, by name as the model writes it. (string)

weight.description: Its share of the aim; the chain's shares usually add up to 1. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

pitchLimit.description: How far this joint alone may pitch, up or down. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

yawLimit.description: How far this joint alone may yaw, left or right. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

weight.description: How much of the aim to apply over the animation. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

graph.description: The anim_graph record it runs. Names a anim_graph record. (RecordId)

model.description: The skinned .glb whose skeleton and clips it plays; left out, the skinned_mesh part's mesh. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

shape.description: Box, Sphere or Capsule; a capsule stands on the origin. Category: Shape. (ColliderShape, default "Box")

size.description: Box only: full extents. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Shape. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

radius.description: Sphere and capsule. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Shape. (float, default 0)

height.description: Capsule only: total height, feet to head. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Shape. (float, default 0)

mass.description: Above 0 it is a dynamic body that falls; 0 is static. Unit: kg. At least 0. Category: Physics. (float, default 0)

trigger.description: Reports overlaps and never blocks. Category: Physics. (bool, default false)

contacts.description: Reports contact begin and end events. Category: Physics. (bool, default false)

layer.description: Physics layer by name; empty = default. Category: Physics. (string, default "")

socket.description: A socket of the parent's model (skeleton_sockets); empty = follow `bone`. (string, default "")

bone.description: A joint by name, when there is no socket. (string, default "")

offset.description: Where this sits in the socket's space. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

angles.description: How this is turned in the socket's space: pitch, yaw, roll. Unit: deg. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

drop.description: Let go, with a dynamic body of its own, when the owner goes ragdoll (a weapon in a hand) (bool, default false)

size.description: Full extents of the box. Unit: m. At least 0. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

material.description: What the box is drawn with. Names a material record. (RecordId)

projection.description: Perspective (3D) or Orthographic (2D, top-down, isometric) (CameraProjection, default "Perspective")

fovY.description: Vertical field of view. Unit: deg. Range: 1 to 179. Category: Perspective. (float, default 45)

orthoHeight.description: How much world the viewport shows, top to bottom. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Orthographic. (float, default 10)

near.description: Near clip plane. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0.1)

far.description: Far clip plane. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 1000)

priority.description: Of the enabled cameras drawing to one target, the highest wins. (int, default 0)

enabled.description: Off: never chosen, whatever its priority. (bool, default true)

viewport.description: The part of the target it draws to, 0..1 from the top-left; empty = all of it. Category: Output. (CameraViewport)

x.description: Left edge, 0..1 of the target's width. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

y.description: Top edge, 0..1 of the target's height. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

width.description: 0..1 of the target's width; 0 = all of it. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

height.description: 0..1 of the target's height; 0 = all of it. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

target.description: The render target it draws to, by name; empty = the screen. Category: Output. (string, default "")

layer.description: Physics layer by name (player, enemy); empty = default. (string, default "")

profile.description: How it moves; empty = the engine's default. Names a movement_profile record. (RecordRef<MovementProfileRecord>)

id.description: What it says when used. Names a dialogue record. (RecordRef<DialogueRecord>)

ids.description: Effects it starts with. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

ids+.description: Adds to "ids": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

ids-.description: Removes these from "ids" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

id.description: The faction it belongs to. Names a faction record. (RecordRef<FactionRecord>)

enabled.description: Off: it leaves the camera's pose alone (the player camera's other rig may be on) (bool, default true)

showBody.description: Draw the followed body from this view (a game with full-body awareness); off hides it. (bool, default false)

pelvis.description: The joint lowered so both feet reach (usually the hips); empty = none. (string, default "")

left.description: The left leg: hip, knee and foot joints. (FootIkLeg)

foot.description: The ankle (what is placed on the ground) (string)

right.description: The right leg: hip, knee and foot joints. (FootIkLeg)

foot.description: The ankle (what is placed on the ground) (string)

footHeight.description: How far the ankle joint sits above the sole. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0.08)

rayAbove.description: The ray starts this far above the animated foot (how high a step it finds) Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0.5)

rayBelow.description: And looks this far below it (how deep a dip it reaches into) Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0.5)

maxPelvisDrop.description: The most the pelvis may drop. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0.4)

weight.description: How much of the correction to apply over the animation. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

model.description: The model whose hitboxes records to use; left out, the skinned_mesh's or the animator's. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

capacity.description: How much it can carry; 0 = no limit. Unit: kg. At least 0. (float, default 0)

items+.description: Adds to "items": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

items-.description: Removes these from "items" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

kind.description: Ball, Hinge, Fixed or Distance. Category: Joint. (JointKind, default "Ball")

target.description: The entity it is joined to, by name; empty = the parent if it has a body, else the world. Category: Joint. (string, default "")

anchor.description: Where the joint is, in this entity's space. Unit: m. Category: Joint. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

targetAnchor.description: Where it is on the target (a world point for the world); left out = the same point as the anchor, where they stand when the joint is made. Unit: m. Category: Joint. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

axis.description: Ball twist axis and hinge axis, in this entity's space; left out = up (+Y) Category: Joint. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

swing.description: Ball: half-angle of the swing cone around the axis; 0 = no cone. Unit: °. Range: 0 to 179. Category: Ball. (float, default 0)

twistMin.description: Ball: twist about the axis; both 0 = free. Unit: °. Range: -180 to 180. Category: Ball. (float, default 0)

twistMax.description: Ball: twist about the axis; both 0 = free. Unit: °. Range: -180 to 180. Category: Ball. (float, default 0)

min.description: Hinge: the angle from rest about the axis; both 0 = free. Unit: °. Range: -180 to 180. Category: Hinge. (float, default 0)

max.description: Hinge: the angle from rest about the axis; both 0 = free. Unit: °. Range: -180 to 180. Category: Hinge. (float, default 0)

minDistance.description: Distance: the least the anchors may be apart. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Distance. (float, default 0)

maxDistance.description: Distance: the most the anchors may be apart; 0 = how far apart they are when it is made. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Distance. (float, default 0)

breakForce.description: The force above which the joint breaks; 0 = never. Unit: N. At least 0. (float, default 0)

drag.description: Air drag: the share of the body's speed (and spin) it loses each second, so a swing settles; 0 = none. Unit: 1/s. At least 0. (float, default 0.5)

colour.description: Linear RGB; 0 0 0 means white. At least 0. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

range.description: Where the light fades to nothing. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 8)

intensity.description: Multiplies the colour; 1 is a lamp. At least 0. (float, default 1)

off.description: Starts switched off; TurnOn, TurnOff and Toggle switch it (a lamp a state machine lights at night) (bool, default false)

scene.description: The scene it leads to. Names a scene record. (RecordRef<SceneRecord>)

entry.description: Where in that scene: a placement's name or a map entity's targetname. (string, default "")

hours.description: Game hours going through takes (0: none) Unit: h. At least 0. (float, default 0)

value.description: True or false to start with. (bool, default false)
The value it starts with. (float, default 0)

compareValue.description: What the value is compared with. (float, default 0)

start.description: The count it starts at, and where Reset puts it. (float, default 0)

min.description: The lowest it goes; OnHitMin when it gets there (limits only when max > min) (float, default 0)

max.description: The highest it goes; OnHitMax when it gets there (limits only when max > min) (float, default 0)

startDisabled.description: Starts disabled: nothing changes it until Enable. (bool, default false)

requires.description: Trigger does nothing unless this holds, asked of the activator (subject) and the relay (other) (ICondition)

then.description: Done on Trigger, before OnTrigger fires: the activator is the subject, the relay the other. (List<IAction>)

then+.description: Adds to "then": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

then-.description: Removes these from "then" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

startDisabled.description: Starts disabled: Trigger does nothing until Enable. (bool, default false)

sameTick.description: OnTrigger's wires with no delay arrive in the same tick rather than the next. (bool, default false)

inMin.description: The input range's start: maps to outMin. (float, default 0)

inMax.description: The input range's end: maps to outMax. (float, default 1)

clamp.description: Keep the result between outMin and outMax, whatever comes in. (bool, default true)

ease.description: The curve between the ends (Linear, QuadInOut, …) (Ease, default "Linear")

attack.description: What it swings. Names a attack record. (RecordRef<AttackRecord>)

natural.description: What it swings bare-handed; empty = the same as attack. Names a attack record. (RecordRef<AttackRecord>)

open.description: Where open is, relative to where it was placed. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

seconds.description: How long the whole trip takes, shut to open. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 1)

speed.description: Above 0: metres a second along its path (degrees a second if it only turns), instead of seconds. At least 0. (float, default 0)

closeAfter.description: Above 0: shuts itself this long after opening. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

onBlocked.description: Reverse (default), Stop or Crush, when something can't be pushed. (MoverBlocked, default "Reverse")

angle.description: How far it turns as it opens (a hinged door: 90) Unit: deg. (float, default 0)

axis.description: What it turns about, in its own frame; default up, a door's hinge. (Vector3, default [0,1,0])

pivot.description: Where the hinge is, from its origin, in its own frame. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

path.description: Stops after the shut one, from where it was placed (a lift's floors); open is the last. Unit: m. (Vector3[])

path+.description: Adds to "path": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

path-.description: Removes these from "path" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

locked.description: Starts locked: refuses to open until it is sent Unlock. (bool, default false)

speed.description: How fast it walks off-screen; 0 = its movement profile's walking speed. Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

strength.description: How hard it fights off-screen: its weight in a round (with its health) and the health it takes when it wins one. At least 0. (float, default 1)

corpse.description: Whether it leaves a corpse when it dies off-screen; false, it is gone. (bool, default true)

fight.description: The rule its off-screen fights are settled by: an offscreen_fight entry. (string, default "strength")

item.description: The item taking it gives you. Names a item record. (RecordRef<ItemRecord>)

quest.description: The quest it listens to: OnStageChanged when it moves. Names a quest record. (RecordRef<QuestRecord>)

record.description: One ragdoll record to use; left out, every ragdoll record for the model. Names a ragdoll record. (RecordId)

onDeath.description: Goes ragdoll when it dies. (bool, default true)

hitImpulse.description: The impulse a damaging hit gives the body nearest where it landed, along the hit. Unit: N*s. At least 0. (float, default 30)

getUpAfter.description: Gets up by itself this long after it has come to rest (never once it has died); 0 = only when told (the GetUp input) Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

getUpBack.description: The animator state it gets up with from lying face up. (string, default "getup_back")

getUpFront.description: The animator state it gets up with from lying face down. (string, default "getup_front")

getUpFade.description: How long the pose it lay in fades into the get-up state. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0.2)

id.description: Its daily routine. Names a routine record. (RecordRef<RoutineRecord>)

holdTime.description: How long CameraOn holds when the wire gives no time; 0 = until CameraOff. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

lockInput.description: While on and drawing to the screen, the local player's movement, look and buttons are held. (bool, default false)

blendTime.description: Seconds CameraOn blends into it from the screen's view when the wire gives none; 0 = a cut. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

blendEase.description: The easing curve of that blend. (Ease, default "SmoothStep")

mesh.description: A .glb with a skin (JOINTS_0 and WEIGHTS_0) A mesh path. (AssetPath)

material.description: Empty = sage:lit_default; its effect needs a Skinned technique. Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

layer.description: Sort layer, drawn in order before material. Range: 0 to 15. (byte, default 0)

sheet.description: The sprite sheet to draw. Names a sprite_sheet record. (RecordRef<SpriteSheetRecord>)

material.description: Empty = the default sprite material. Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

size.description: Width and height; 0 = the sheet's own. Unit: m. At least 0. (Vector2, default [0,0])

animation.description: A clip name to play; empty = don't animate. (string, default "")

graph.description: An anim_graph whose clips are this sheet's: it picks the clip, and its clip events land blows (issue #119) Names a anim_graph record. (RecordRef<AnimGraphRecord>)

machine.description: The state_machine record it runs; it starts in that machine's initial state. Names a state_machine record. (RecordId)

enabled.description: Off: it leaves the camera's pose alone (the player camera's other rig may be on) (bool, default true)

distance.description: How far behind the shoulder, along the view, when nothing is in the way. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 3)

shoulderOffset.description: From the eye, in the view's frame: x right, y up, z back. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0.45,0.25,0])

probeRadius.description: Radius of the sphere swept from the head to keep the camera out of walls. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Collision. (float, default 0.25)

collision.description: Physics layers the probe stops at, by name; empty = every layer. Category: Collision. (List<string>)

collision+.description: Adds to "collision": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

collision-.description: Removes these from "collision" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

smoothing.description: How long it takes to ease back out once the way clears; 0 = at once. Unit: s. At least 0. Category: Collision. (float, default 0.3)

interval.description: Seconds between one OnTimer and the next. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 1)

spread.description: Each wait is the interval plus or minus up to this much, at random. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

repeat.description: Fire every interval (on), or once and stop (off) (bool, default true)

startOn.description: Start counting as soon as it is spawned; off: wait for TimerStart. (bool, default false)

seed.description: Where the random stream for `spread` starts; 0 = from the entity. (uint, default 0)

label.description: What a map or `travel` calls it; empty: the entity's name. (string, default "")

radius.description: How near the player must come to discover it. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 20)

discovered.description: Known from the start, without going there. (bool, default false)

channel.description: What a TweenTo with no channel moves: Position, Rotation or Scale. (TweenChannel, default "Position")

target.description: Where a TweenTo with no numbers goes: metres, degrees (pitch, yaw, roll) or scale factors. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

relative.description: The target is from where it is (moved by, turned by, scaled by) rather than where it ends up. (bool, default false)

duration.description: How long a TweenTo with no seconds takes. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 1)

ease.description: The easing curve a TweenTo with no curve uses. (Ease, default "SmoothStep")

record.description: What it shows to start with; empty = nothing until gameplay picks one. Names a viewmodel record. (RecordId)

enabled.description: Off: nothing is drawn. (bool, default true)

fovY.description: Its own vertical field of view; 0 = the camera's. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 179. (float, default 54)

near.description: Its own near plane. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0.01)

far.description: Its own far plane. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 10)
